trace.final:
All done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Reviewed deployment history** — found v2.3.1 was unhealthy in production; the most recent healthy production release was v2.3.0.
2. **Rolled back all production regions** (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to v2.3.0 — confirmed rolled_out across all regions.
3. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (INC-0001, on-call paged) documenting that v2.3.1 was failing health checks and that a full rollback to v2.3.0 was performed.
4. **Verified post-rollback health** — checkout-api is now `healthy: true` on v2.3.0 across all regions, with a low error rate (0.002).

Note: v2.3.1 was never healthy in production, so per policy any future re-deploy of it will require change-manager approval before it can proceed.
